key_kinds.craft: A recipe label from nc.register_craft; discovered by performing that craft (stored as craft:<label>).
key_kinds.item: An item/node name; discovered by holding, seeing, digging or placing it.
key_kinds.event: A player event key: dig:, place:, inv:, look:, punch:, hurt:, etc.
key_kinds.group: An item group; granted by discovering any item in that group.
key_kinds.toolcap: toolcap:<diggroup>:<level>; granted by holding a tool that digs that group at that level.

groups.activates_lens: always activates optics lenses, regardless of light_source
groups.adobe: any node made of adobe (patterned, bricked, etc)
groups.always_scalable: nodes that can always be scaled even if they define on_rightclick
groups.attached_node: built-in: drops as item if node below is removed
groups.cheat: having posession of this item represents a form of cheat (e.g. admin tool)
groups.chisel: metal shaft that can be used as a chisel with a mallet
groups.coalstone: any node made of tarstone (patterned, bricked, etc)
groups.cobbley: any "cobble with filler" type node (e.g. ores)
groups.concrete_etchable: (api-managed) concrete nodes that can be etched
groups.container: container grade; can only be placed inside containers of higher grade
groups.crumbly: dig group: spades, mattocks, and adzes
groups.damage_pickup: damage to deal player when trying to pick up
groups.damage_radiant: amount of radiant heat emitted that damages players slowly
groups.damage_touch: damage to deal player when punching or trying to pick up
groups.door_panel: level of door that a panel would make if it were hinged
groups.dungeon_mapgen: dungeon nodes that are replaced with real ones after mapgen
groups.dynamic_light: light level of invisible dynamic lights from nc_api_active
groups.ember: (specific) fuel level of burning nc_fire embers
groups.falling_mapgen_ignore: falling nodes that are ignored by mapgen falling node removal
groups.falling_node: built-in: falls as a node if not supported below
groups.falling_repose: angle of repose for falling nodes, higher is steeper
groups.fire_fuel: for flammable nodes, convert into ember of this grade (1-8)
groups.firestick: can be rubbed against another firestick to make fire; success rate factor
groups.flame_ambiance: emits crackling fire ambiance (e.g. flames, torches)
groups.flammable: can catch fire; becomes ember if fire_fuel, or flame otherwise
groups.float: built-in: falling node lands on top of liquids
groups.flora_dry: decorative plants that are dry (dried rushes, wilted flowers, all sedges)
groups.flower_mutant: flowers that are not found in mapgen
groups.grassable: grass can spread onto this node (converting substrate to dirt)
groups.green: things containing significant amounts of living plant matter
groups.hard_stone: stratum of hard stone for stone, ores, and similar
groups.igniter: causes nearby flammable things to ignite
groups.is_stack_only: (specific) a bare item stack as a node
groups.leaf_decay: decays into its leaf_decay_as items if not connected to tree trunk
groups.leaf_decay_support: nodes that stop leaves from decaying (tree trunks)
groups.leaf_decay_transmit: nodes that transmit leaf decay stoppage through them (leaves)
groups.lode_cobble: (specific) lode cobble or loose lode cobble
groups.lode_cube: full cubes made of lode (lode cubes, crates)
groups.lode_temper_annealed: any lode thing in a slow-cooled and workable state
groups.lode_temper_hot: any lode thing in a heated and glowing
groups.lode_temper_tempered: any lode thing in a quenched and hardened state
groups.lodey: stone with lode in various states
groups.log: tree trunks and logs, can be split to planks
groups.loose_repack: loose nodes that self-repack over time
groups.lux_absorb: lux radiation absorption proportion in 64ths of total
groups.lux_cobble: lux cobble that reacts to nearby lux cobble
groups.lux_cobble_max: lux cobble that produces lux flows
groups.lux_emit: things that emit lux radiation that irradiates players over time
groups.lux_hot: lux cobble in a moderately excited but still subcritical state
groups.lux_rock: lux rock in smooth-stone or cobble form (for ore hints)
groups.metallic: made of metal, efficiently absorbs lux radiation
groups.moist: water or other source of moisture esp. for plant cultivation
groups.nc_api_rotate_above: rotate when in pointed_thing above location
groups.nc_api_rotate_under: rotate when in pointed_thing under location
groups.nc_concrete_etched: (api-managed) any non-pliant concrete node with etched patterns
groups.nc_concrete_pattern_bindy: (api-managed) any type of concrete with a bindy pattern
groups.nc_concrete_pattern_boxy: (api-managed) any type of concrete with a boxy pattern
groups.nc_concrete_pattern_bricky: (api-managed) any type of concrete with a bricky pattern
groups.nc_concrete_pattern_hashy: (api-managed) any type of concrete with a hashy pattern
groups.nc_concrete_pattern_horzy: (api-managed) any type of concrete with a horzy pattern
groups.nc_concrete_pattern_iceboxy: (api-managed) any type of concrete with a iceboxy pattern
groups.nc_concrete_pattern_vermy: (api-managed) any type of concrete with a vermy pattern
groups.nc_concrete_pattern_verty: (api-managed) any type of concrete with a verty pattern
groups.nc_concrete_pliant: (api-managed) any type of concrete in a pliant state
groups.nc_door_scuff_opacity: override opacity of scuff texture when making door
groups.nc_doors_pummel_first: test for pummel recipes before dig when used by door
groups.nc_lantern_charged: (specific) lux lantern with significant charge level
groups.nc_scaling_fx: display black dust mote particles like scaling spots
groups.optic_gluable: any optic that can be glued in place with an eggcorn
groups.optic_lens: equivalent/replaceable by a lens when held in inventory
groups.optic_lens_emit: a lens emitting a full-intensity beam (firestart, ablate)
groups.optic_opaque: force node to be opaque to optic beams
groups.optic_transparent: force node to be transparent to optic beams
groups.peat_grindable_item: stack of 8 can be ground into peat automatically
groups.peat_grindable_node: single one can be ground into peat automatically
groups.pumice_no_support: does not provide support to pumice structures
groups.radiant_opaque: force radiant heat damage to be blocked
groups.radiant_transparent: force radiant heat damage to pass through
groups.raked: a node whose surface has been raked
groups.rakey: is a rake tool, can rake line patterns into sand/gravel
groups.rock: all non-glassy rocky/stony things, including stone, cobble, brick, etc
groups.sandstone: any node made of sandstone (patterned, bricked, etc)
groups.scaling_time: percentage time it takes to scale this node
groups.silica: any glass, can be ground back to sand
groups.silica_clear: any clear glass, grinds to crude, passes light
groups.silica_lens: equivalent to only half a node of sand by weight
groups.smoothstone: smooth stone that can be chiseled to bricks
groups.soil: dirt that provides nutrients to plant growth
groups.stack_as_node: single items landing on ground should be placed as node
groups.stone: variants of smooth stone, including ones with inclusions (ore)
groups.stone_bricks: smooth stone that's been chiseled into bricks
groups.storebox_sealed: storage container that's airtight (sponges) if open sides covered
groups.support_falling: falling_nodes can rest on it even if not walkable
groups.tongs_pickup: can be picked up and held using tongs
groups.tongs_wear_add_percent: adjust rate of wear on tongs
groups.torch_lit: (specific) lit torches, subject to various events/timers
groups.totable: nodes that can be packed up into a tote
groups.visinv: display nc.stack_get() stack as an entity in node
groups.visinv_hidden: hide visinv ent; it's baked into the node model already
groups.witness_opaque: force things to be treated as opaque for hint witnessing
groups.witness_transparent: force things to be treated as transparent for hint witnessing

group:chisel.note: Lode bars/rods/ladders are the metal shafts usable as chisels.

group:concrete_powder.note: Applied by the concrete API to every dry mix powder.

group:door.note: A panel only becomes a hinged door once pinned.

group:optic_gluable.note: Lenses and prisms are the gluable optics.

group:peat_grindable_item.note: Loose dead plant matter: dry leaves, eggcorns, rushes, sedges.

group:rakey.note: Rakes proper, plus thatch/wicker which rake while wielded.

group:smoothstone.note: Plain stone carries this group and is visible everywhere underground, so looking at it grants the key with no hint behind it.

group:totable.note: Shelves/crates are what a tote can pick up.

toolcap:choppy:4.note: Needs an assembled lode hatchet (annealed level 4). No hint covers the 'assemble lode hatchet' craft itself, so this points at the forging/annealing steps that lead to it.

toolcap:thumpy:3.note: Wooden mallets are only level 2; a stone-tipped mallet (level 3) is the first tool that satisfies this.

nc_tree:humus.note: Humus is what fermenting a peat block yields.

nc_fire:lump_coal.note: Coal lumps come from chopping a charcoal node down.

nc_concrete:aggregate.note: Concrete mix recipes are generated by the concrete API, so the recipe scan cannot read their outputs statically.

nc_sponge:sponge_wet.note: A dry sponge becomes wet by absorbing water via ABM, not by a recipe, so the dry sponge is the real prerequisite.

lode anvil.note: Discovered on completing any craft atop a lode anvil.

nc_lode:prill_hot.note: Draining lode cobble is what yields glowing prills.

nc_lode:prill_annealed.note: Annealing applies to any lode item; the hints only name the cube, so this points at the same annealing step.

forge lode toolhead_pick.note: One 'forge lode <head>' recipe exists per tool head; the hints only name the mallet.

nc_lode:tool_mallet_tempered.note: Temper the head, then assemble it onto a staff.

nc_lode:tool_hatchet_tempered.note: As above; the tempering hint only names the mallet head.
